rites.name: Tentamraeno
rites.text: Tentamraeno is the concept of Oriellys as it was first sounded in the Singing, when the roots of the world began to condense out of resonance. In the Age of Strangers it was the thread outsiders pulled to anchor their own holdings to the shifting ground, and traders learned to measure their debts by its pitch.

rites.name: Shithazora
rites.text: Shithazora is a concept of Oriellys held in the Courts, the divine councils where the doors between worlds were first argued into being during the Age of the first sovereign. It is remembered as the principle that a trial may be survived only by one who has already accepted the grove that will grow from it.

rites.name: Syithasha
rites.text: Syithasha is the concept of the Weave, the quiet web of growing magic that the makers planted across Oriellys during the Seeding. It is not a being but a pattern that stirs in groves and kingdoms, binding roots, rivers, and first sovereigns into a shared rhythm of renewal.

rites.name: Guthougok
rites.text: Guthougok is the concept of the Weave as it is planted in Oriellys during the Seeding, when the makers sink quiet powers into the ground and sleep waits beneath them. In the Holy Age that follows, its flame is kept by temples and orders who tend it like a hearth. Its strength is measured less in what it breaks than in what it holds steady.

rites.name: Anamakaroma
rites.text: Anamakaroma is the concept of the Weave as it is laid into the world during the Seeding, when the makers pass the threads of quiet power into the earth and sleeping forces wake beneath the temples. Its name is spoken in the Holy Age by the orders who tend the flame and keep the threads from tangling. It is remembered less as a being than as the pattern every working of that age must follow.

rites.name: Osumataneno
rites.text: Osumataneno is a concept of the Arcane Realm of Oriellys, the name given to the principle by which the Pact's oaths were bound into the broken worlds during the Holy Age. It was never a being but a rule of flame and sworn word that the temples and orders carried forward through the Sundering and the Shards.

rites.name: Viasilia
rites.text: Viasilia is a concept in Oriellys, a principle of the Walled Age that holds that a road is only real once someone has walked it to the far side. Its orders of wardens and grove-keepers teach that every wall is a promise to be kept and every crossing a debt to be repaid. Its adherents mark first crossings with standing stones that outlast the kingdoms that raised them.

rites.name: Syuthith
rites.text: Syuthith is the concept of Oriellys's branching endings, pictured in the Holy Age as a lattice of candles that each flicker into a different future. Its orders keep the Library's shelves in flame-lit order, and its temples measure each outcome before it is allowed to become real.

rites.name: Sezeth
rites.text: Sezeth is the concept of branching endings, a presence that walks the shelves of the Library where every possible outcome of Oriellys is catalogued. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall split old alliances apart, Sezeth was said to whisper which futures remained open to those who could hear it.
